I'll pull the job log and look up the catalog item in parallel.Now I'll fetch both agnosticv config files in parallel to find where the team prefix is defined.All data is in hand. Here is the complete picture.

---

## Root Cause

**The refused name:** `Tidewater_Ops-m2wjr-team1` (and teams 2–4).

**Why OpenShift rejects it:** Kubernetes Namespace names must comply with **RFC 1123 DNS labels** — only lowercase alphanumeric characters and hyphens (`-`), starting and ending with an alphanumeric character. The underscore (`_`) in `Tidewater_Ops` is **not a legal character**. OpenShift returned HTTP 422 Unprocessable Entity for all four namespace creation attempts.

---

## Where the name comes from

The prefix `Tidewater_Ops` is set directly in the agnosticv `common.yaml`:

```
rhpds/agnosticv:summit_bu/coastal-sre-bootcamp/common.yaml:17
team_projects_prefix: Tidewater_Ops
```

The `ocp4_workload_team_projects` role constructs namespace names as:
`{team_projects_prefix}-{guid}-team{N}` → `Tidewater_Ops-m2wjr-team1`

The underscore in the prefix propagates directly into the namespace name.

---

## Fix

Change the prefix to an all-lowercase, hyphen-only value:

```yaml
# common.yaml line 17 — before
team_projects_prefix: Tidewater_Ops

# after
team_projects_prefix: tidewater-ops
```

This produces namespace names like `tidewater-ops-m2wjr-team1`, which satisfy the RFC 1123 regex `[a-z0-9]([-a-z0-9]*[a-z0-9])?`.

---

**Sources:** [AAP2 job #731608](https://event0.aap.infra.demo.redhat.com/#/jobs/playbook/731608) (event0 controller), [rhpds/agnosticv:summit_bu/coastal-sre-bootcamp/common.yaml](https://github.com/rhpds/agnosticv/blob/main/summit_bu/coastal-sre-bootcamp/common.yaml)
